body.statement: The polytope \(\Pi_T(p)\) is nonempty if and only if \(p\) is armwise normalized and \(p^0_{xy}+p^1_{x,1-y}\leq1\) for every \(x\in T\) and \(y\in\{0,1\}\). After reserving nonnegative masses \(r_s\) and \(r_t\) on \((s,s)\) and \((t,t)\), the residual coupling exists if and only if \(r_s\leq u\), \(r_t\leq v\), and \(r_s+r_t\leq h_{cy}\) for every trusted nuisance cell; these conditions include all boundary strata.
body.justification: The singleton Hall cuts of a complete bipartite graph minus a partial matching yield exactly the individual and total residual caps.
body.gap: Full-exclusion observed compatibility is known, but the residual-cap statement after reserving target diagonals is the unverified completion step specific to the proposed projection.
body.consumer: A finite augmenting-path construction from these conditions certifies every endpoint law, including zero cells and saturated inequalities.
